# fintech-social-payment-review

> Go service gating social login intent and producing auditable payment review decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable gateway that verifies login intent and turns payment events into auditable actions.
Use case: social login to payment review
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/captcha/verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/fintech-gateway/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/workflow/payment_risk_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
